description: Tests the connection to a data sink destination by writing a small test object under the configured prefix, then deleting it. Give either the ID of a saved data sink, or an unsaved destination with its credentials. A successful check does not prove multipart upload or SSE-KMS permissions.

cleanupError.description: Why the test object could not be deleted, when it could not.
cleanupError.title: cleanupError

dataSinkID.description: The ID of the saved data sink to test.
dataSinkID.title: dataSinkID

s3.description: An unsaved S3 destination to test, including its credentials.
s3.title: s3

status.description: Succeeded when the object was written and deleted. WriteFailed when it could not be written. CleanupFailed when it was written but could not be deleted: the destination is usable, but remove the test object.
status.title: status

testKey.description: The key of the test object.
testKey.title: testKey

type.description: The type of the unsaved destination.
type.title: type

title: DataSinkCheck
